title: Speedy Spinach and Ricotta Fiore Ravioli
subtitle: with Walnuts and Sunflower Seeds
description: Five easy steps, minimal pans and prep… we cut the fluff but not the flavour in our speedy recipes. In just 20 minutes, you’ll have this masterpiece on the table and be crowned in glory too!

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Bring a large saucepan of salted water to the boil for the ravioli. Finely chop the tomato. Finely chop the parsley leaves, discarding the stems.

Toast nuts and seeds: Put the walnuts and sunflower seeds in a cold medium deep frypan over medium heat. Toast, tossing, for 3-4 mins until evenly golden. Add 2 tsp red pesto, a drizzle of olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Cook, tossing, for 1 min or until well coated. Remove from the pan, reserving the pan.
Cook ravioli: Cook the ravioli in the pan of boiling water for 3 mins or until al dente. Reserve 80ml (⅓ cup) cooking water, then drain the ravioli.

Simmer sauce: Meanwhile, heat a drizzle of olive oil in the reserved pan over medium heat. Cook the tomato, stirring, for 2 mins or until softened. Season with salt and pepper. Add the tomato paste, remaining red pesto and reserved cooking water and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to low and cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 mins or until slightly thickened.

Serve up: Add the ravioli to the sauce and gently stir to combine. Remove the pan from the heat. Taste, then season with salt and pepper. Divide the ravioli among bowls and scatter over the parsley and toasted nuts and seeds. Enjoy!
Make it yours: If you like your pasta extra cheesy, serve with finely grated parmesan.
